post.subject: Version 4.5 Event Warp: Phase I
post.content:
Hello, Trailblazers!

The Event Warp period for this phase is from after the Version 4.5 update on 2026/08/26 – 2026/09/12 11:59 (server time), and includes the following content:


▌"Summer Chorus" and "Brilliant Fixation: Rise and Sing" Event Warps


● During the "Summer Chorus" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character Robin • Summeretto (Remembrance: Wind) and the 4-star characters Dan Heng (The Hunt: Wind), Qingque (Erudition: Quantum), and Gallagher (Abundance: Fire) will be boosted for a limited time.

● During the "Brilliant Fixation: Rise and Sing" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone Rise and Sing (Remembrance) and the 4-star Light Cones Dream's Montage (Abundance), Geniuses' Greetings (Remembrance), and A Little Getaway (Elation) will be boosted for a limited time.


▌"A Rainbow onto Twilight" & "Bygone Reminiscence: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky" Event Warps


● During the "A Rainbow onto Twilight" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character Hyacine (Remembrance: Wind) and 4-star characters Dan Heng (The Hunt: Wind), Qingque (Erudition: Quantum), and Gallagher (Abundance: Fire) will be boosted for a limited time.

● During the "Bygone Reminiscence: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky (Remembrance) and 4-star Light Cones Dream's Montage (Abundance), Geniuses' Greetings (Remembrance), and A Little Getaway (Elation) will be boosted for a limited time.

▌ Event Warp Details

※ Among the above characters and Light Cones, limited characters and limited Light Cones will not be available in the Stellar Warp event.

※ In this phase of Warp, obtainable 5-star characters include the featured 5-star characters and the custom-selected characters from "Celestial Invitation."

※ During the Event Warp, the limited 5-star character Robin • Summeretto (Remembrance: Wind) can only be obtained from the Character Event Warp "Summer Chorus," while the limited 5-star character Hyacine (Remembrance: Wind) can only be obtained from the Character Event Warp "A Rainbow onto Twilight."

※ During the Event Warp, the limited 5-star Light Cone Rise and Sing (Remembrance) can only be obtained from the Light Cone Event Warp "Brilliant Fixation: Rise and Sing," while the limited 5-star Light Cone Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky (Remembrance) can only be obtained from the Light Cone Event Warp "Bygone Reminiscence: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky."

※ "Summer Chorus" and "A Rainbow onto Twilight" are considered Character Event Warps, and share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star character in any Character Event Warp will always be carried over to other Character Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.

※ "Brilliant Fixation: Rise and Sing" and "Bygone Reminiscence: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky" are considered Light Cone Event Warps, and share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star Light Cone in any Light Cone Event Warp will always be carried over to other Light Cone Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.

※ For more information, please head to the Warp screen.


▌ "Aptitude Showcase" Character Trial Event

● Requirement: Unlock Travel Log

● Event Period: After the Version 4.5 update on 2026/08/26 – 2026/09/12 11:59 (server time)

● Event Details: The trial characters Robin • Summeretto (Remembrance: Wind), Hyacine (Remembrance: Wind), Dan Heng (The Hunt: Wind), Qingque (Erudition: Quantum), and Gallagher (Abundance: Fire) can be used to experience stages. Upon completing the challenges, Trailblazers can obtain Stellar Jades, Adventure Logs, Universal Enhancement Materials, and credits.


▌ "Celestial Invitation" Custom Characters

● Trailblazers can customize 7 "Celestial Invitation" characters in the Character Event Warp. The selectable characters are as follows.

※ The first time you obtain a 5-star character in this Warp event, there is a 50% chance that it will be one of the featured 5-star characters. There is also a 50% chance that it will be any of the obtainable 5-star characters in this Warp phase, with equal chance among them.

※ If the Celestial Invitation characters include this phase's featured 5-star character, when you fail to trigger the 50% chance to immediately obtain the featured 5-star character, you will obtain 1 character from the featured character and 7 Celestial Invitation characters. The Celestial Invitation characters each have a consistent 12.5% drop rate while the featured character is at 25%.

※ Regardless of whether you trigger the featured guarantee, it will be reset when you obtain the featured character.
